Given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta =\frac{1}{2},$ calculate the area (in square units) of $△ABC$ shown above.
question.worked_solution:
In this case, the area of the right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC.
$$

We are given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta =\frac{1}{2},$ where $\theta =m∠B.$ Notice we're also given the length of the side $\overset{―}{AC}$ opposite to $∠B.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to find the length of the adjacent side $\overset{―}{BC}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta  & =\frac{AC}{BC} \\ \frac{1}{2} & =\frac{3}{BC} \\ BC & =\frac{2}{1}\cdot 3 \\ BC & =6\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 3\cdot 6 \\  & =9.\end{aligned}
$$
